title: sse-delimiter-heuristic-and-atomic-json-span-repair
author: Priya Kannan
description: Motivation: Intermittent production incidents showed truncated JSON objects in streamed responses when delimiters and UTF-8 token boundaries aligned poorly across transport chunks. This surfaced in OpenAI-compatible streams and caused downstream JSON parsers to fail or drop function-call frames. This PR introduces a conservative delimiter heuristic and an atomic-span repair pass in the SSE coalescer so partial JSON objects are never emitted without an explicit repair boundary. Summary of changes: 1) Add a delimiter-heuristic layer that marks potential mid-object delimiter splits and delays emission until a short lookahead window confirms boundary integrity. 2) Implement an atomic-json-span-repair step that reconstructs and resynchronizes incomplete object fragments by using lightweight checksum and sentinel markers when available. 3) Preserve original event ordering by tagging tentative fragments and enforcing deterministic replay order when repair is applied. 4) Tighten OpenAI-compat rules for function call sentinel handling so function_call/finish events cannot be interleaved with partial JSON emits. Compatibility: backward compatible with existing client integrations; behavior toggled by feature flag sse.atomic_span_repair (defaults to on for hosted). Testing: unit tests for corner splits, fuzz harness runs against random chunking, integration tests with openai-compat streaming harness, and end-to-end smoke in staging. Rollout: staged rollout to canaries, then gradual region rollout with metric gating (json_repair_rate, sse_latency_p50/p95).
commits: parser: add delimiter heuristic and unit tests
coalescer: implement atomic-json-span-repair and sentinel tagging
compat: tighten function_call delimiter rules for openai layer
tests: add fuzz harness and new e2e scenario for truncated object
ci: add metrics gating config for rollout
review_comments: Marco Diaz commented: Can we simplify the lookahead window heuristic to avoid an extra allocation? The current impl clones fragments; prefer zero-copy where possible.
Priya Kannan replied: Updated coalescer to use a borrowing slice for lookahead and removed one allocation; benchmark unchanged for p50 and improved p99 slightly.
Li Wei commented: The checksum heuristic sounds good but could collide on tiny fragments. Please add a defensive fallback to byte-wise resync.
Priya Kannan replied: Added a two-tier fallback: checksum+length then deterministic byte-resync for <16 byte fragments; added tests.
Samantha Ortiz requested changes: add a feature flag to toggle behavior in private installs and document operational impacts.
Priya Kannan replied: Added deploy/feature_flags.yaml entry and expanded docs/compatibility/streaming.md to describe flag and rollout plan.
Marco Diaz approved: lgtm after allocation fix and tests.
Li Wei approved: Verified fuzz harness results in staging.
Samantha Ortiz approved: Docs and flags look good.
release_notes: Fixes: Prevents emission of truncated JSON objects in SSE streams by adding a delimiter heuristic and atomic-json-span repair. Improves function_call sentinel ordering in OpenAI compatibility layer. Operational: feature flag sse.atomic_span_repair controls behavior for Private installs. Monitoring: new metrics json_repair_rate and sse_repair_latency.
